visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat wearing a purple floral sweater and a white apron stands behind a street market stall. It wears pink gloves and is seen wrapping or arranging green bamboo-wrapped zongzi on a metallic counter. The background is a dense market scene with Chinese signage, stacks of food items, and hanging merchandise under bright fluorescent lighting. (2) The scene transitions to an indoor kitchen environment where the cat, appearing larger, stands in front of an open refrigerator that is overflowing with hundreds of zongzi. As the cat observes, the pile collapses, burying the cat in a cascade of falling green dumplings. (3) Returning to the market stall, the cat continues its task, handing a finished zongzi to an off-screen hand. The cat's expression is focused and diligent. The stall features various side dishes like salted egg yolks and steamed buns. (4) The refrigerator scene is repeated, showing the comedic impact of the dumplings falling on the cat once more, emphasizing the quantity of the food items in a chaotic spill.
